prs.title: feat(verify-pr): preflight execution approvals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an execution preflight for maintainer-driven local `/verify-pr` rounds. Legacy watcher commands that omit `--execution` retain their container meaning, while a host or VM selection is now explicit and is validated before artifacts are created or untrusted PR code runs. A maintainer can trust their own or a same-repository PR locally with `--trust-pr-head` after an explicit decision, without publishing an approval comment. For another fork, an approval comment is coupled with a real in-flight watch registration bound to the matching repository, PR, head, and round. Reusing a completed round's comment no longer authorizes another execution. Publication compares the artifact declaration with prepare's host-held approval, requires the context digest, checks eligibility again, and canonicalizes the entire registration path so an intermediate symlink cannot redirect it into the PR clone.

## Why it's needed

The local workflow already said that host execution required a maintainer's approval, but the only executable check was performed while preparing the publication comment. A host round could therefore run the entire battery before asking for evidence that should have existed beforehand. This moves the supported workflow's checks earlier, makes approval externally auditable, and avoids turning a private trust decision for a maintainer's own or shared-repository PR into a mandatory public comment.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) and [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md). They cover the compatibility choices, approval model, trust boundaries, test plan, and deferrals.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm that a legacy coordinate prepare without `--execution` completes in container mode and does not create `executionApproval` or a host declaration. Verify that host or VM still requires an explicit execution selection and cannot silently inherit this compatibility default.
2. For a maintainer's own fork and for a same-repository collaboration PR, check explicit `--trust-pr-head`. The authenticated maintainer's own identity and write/maintain/admin permission are verified, the approval names the exact current head and round, and another fork or read-only identity fails before the artifact directory appears. Author or repository matching alone is not an automatic waiver.
3. For another fork, register the exact head and round, then use a marked maintainer approval comment with `--approval` and its PR-external `--state-root`. Preparing a retry while that registration is in flight works. After the real watch completion, repeating the same command fails with exit 3 rather than replaying the old approval into a later execution. Wrong heads, rounds, comment targets, permissions, and missing or nested-symlinked registration paths also fail before preparation succeeds.
4. Inspect a host/VM publication. The artifact declaration and the host-held `executionApproval` must be deeply equal and its context must match `--context-sha256`; a missing digest, altered permission/source/basis/comment/head/round, or forged PR-side context is refused. Existing container and CI-lane declarations should remain unaffected.
5. Run the six affected suites (`verify-pr-prepare`, `verify-pr-check`, `verify-pr-model-proxy`, `verify-pr-watch-state`, `verify-pr-guard`, and `qwen-triage-workflow`): 657 tests passed and 16 skipped on macOS. The real helper E2E matrix passed 81/81 cells, followed by a separate symlink-containment regression that failed before its fix and passed afterward. Four removal controls became red when the container default, registration check, declaration-write error handling, or containment guard was removed, then returned green after exact restoration.

Verification also passed `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, `node dist/cli.js --version` (0.28.0), `npm run format`, `npm run lint`, and `git diff --check`. A full scripts run with the macOS temporary-directory alias removed reported 5048 passed, 89 skipped, and one infrastructure-rerun timeout in an unchanged autofix test; that same test passed in isolation in 16.2 seconds. No assertion or timeout was weakened. The local E2E used disposable clones and fake `gh`, never a real PR battery or a GitHub write API.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for this non-UI change. The supporting local E2E log is `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`; it records command exits, completed watch registrations, publication tamper cases, and the original in-flight retry versus completed-round replay. It is a git-ignored fixture log, not a PR code artifact.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Local Node.js 24.18.1 with a frozen-lockfile install, full workspace build, targeted tests, real helper CLIs, disposable git clones, and fake GitHub responses. The `/var` to `/private/var` macOS alias was reproduced separately in the baseline lint-scope fixture; its unmodified test passes with `TMPDIR=/private/tmp`. No daemons, persistent watches, real approval comments, external-image uploads, or PR-battery execution were used in the E2E harness.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This is a fail-closed workflow around trusted prepare and publish commands, not an operating-system sandbox. It cannot prove that subsequent commands stay inside the chosen boundary or prevent a caller from bypassing prepare and opening a shell. It also validates maintainers through live GitHub identity and permission APIs, so transient preflight failures reject VM/host execution rather than silently degrading it.
- Not validated / out of scope: Prepare does not revalidate a comment's later deletion or the revocation of permission after the preflight. Mandatory execution confinement is deferred. The unrelated, load-sensitive autofix timeout remains an existing test-budget issue and is disclosed above rather than hidden.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Legacy container coordinate calls remain compatible, including old watch snapshots. Legacy host/VM artifacts without the host-held approval and verified context digest are intentionally rejected: use a real container or run the new preflight. Comment-backed fresh rounds also need a real watch registration; a verifier for a maintainer's own or same-repository PR can instead use explicit `--trust-pr-head` without a public approval comment.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次改动

为维护者在本地发起的 `/verify-pr` 轮次增加执行预检。旧 watch 命令即使省略 `--execution`，仍保留原有 container 语义；宿主或 VM 则必须显式选择，并在创建产物或运行不可信 PR 代码之前完成验证。维护者明确决定后，可用 `--trust-pr-head` 在本地信任本人或同仓 PR，不必公开发布批准评论。对于他人的 fork，批准评论必须与真实 in-flight watch 注册配合，绑定对应的仓库、PR、head 和 round，完成后复用旧评论不能再授权新的执行。发布时把产物声明与 prepare 写入宿主侧的批准进行对账，强制核对 context digest 并重新检查资格；注册路径的完整规范化也会阻止中间软链把它带回 PR 克隆。

## 为什么需要

本地工作流原本就要求宿主执行前获得维护者批准，但唯一的机器检查在生成发布评论时才执行。宿主轮次因此可能先运行完整测试，再补上本应在执行前具备的批准证据。本 PR 将受支持流程中的检查前移，使批准可审计，并避免把维护者对本人或同仓 PR 的私人信任决定强制变成公开评论。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.md) 与 [中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/feat/verify-pr-execution-preflight/docs/design/verify-pr-execution-preflight.zh-CN.md)，覆盖兼容选择、批准模型、信任边界、测试计划与后续事项。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 确认不带 `--execution` 的旧 coordinate prepare 仍能以 container 模式完成，且不产生 `executionApproval` 或宿主声明。宿主/VM 仍必须显式选择执行方式，不能通过该兼容默认值静默获得豁免。
2. 对维护者本人的 fork 与同仓协作 PR，验证显式 `--trust-pr-head`：会核验当前认证维护者以及其 write/maintain/admin 权限，批准绑定当前完整 head 和 round；他人 fork 或只读身份在创建产物目录之前失败。作者或仓库匹配单独并不构成自动豁免。
3. 对他人 fork，先注册精确 head 与 round，再将带标记的维护者批准评论连同 `--approval`、位于 PR 外的 `--state-root` 一起使用。原注册仍在 in-flight 时允许重试 prepare；真实 watch 完成后，同一命令必须以 exit 3 拒绝，不能把旧批准重放到后续执行。错误 head、round、评论目标、权限，以及缺失或嵌套软链的注册路径，也都会在 prepare 成功前失败。
4. 检查宿主/VM 发布内容：产物声明与宿主持有的 `executionApproval` 必须深度相同，context 必须匹配 `--context-sha256`；缺少 digest，篡改 permission/source/basis/comment/head/round，或伪造 PR 侧 context，都必须被拒绝。原有 container 与 CI-lane 声明不受影响。
5. 运行六套受影响测试（`verify-pr-prepare`、`verify-pr-check`、`verify-pr-model-proxy`、`verify-pr-watch-state`、`verify-pr-guard`、`qwen-triage-workflow`）：macOS 上 657 passed、16 skipped。真实 helper E2E 通过 81/81 格，随后另行的软链 containment 回归在修复前失败、修复后通过。四个去修复对照分别在移除 container 默认值、注册校验、声明写入异常处理或 containment 守卫时转红，恢复原实现后转绿。

同时已通过 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、`node dist/cli.js --version`（0.28.0）、`npm run format`、`npm run lint` 与 `git diff --check`。移除 macOS 临时目录别名后的全量脚本测试报告 5048 passed、89 skipped、1 个既有 autofix 基础设施重跑用例超时；同一用例独立运行以 16.2 秒通过。没有弱化任何断言或超时。全部 E2E 使用一次性克隆与 fake `gh`，未执行真实 PR 电池或 GitHub 写接口。

### Before / After 证据

本改动不涉及 UI。辅助证据留存于本地 `verify-pr-execution-preflight-revised-20261122-022953/report.md`，包含命令退出状态、完整 watch 注册、发布篡改矩阵，以及原 in-flight 重试与完成后重放的区别。该文件是 git-ignored 测试日志，不属于要提交的代码产物。

### 已测试系统

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 24.18.1 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

本机 Node.js 24.18.1，按 lockfile 安装依赖，完整构建工作区，并运行目标测试、真实 helper CLI、一次性 git 克隆与 fake GitHub 响应。已在基线 lint-scope 夹具中单独复现 macOS 的 `/var` 到 `/private/var` 路径别名；未修改的测试在 `TMPDIR=/private/tmp` 下通过。E2E 没有使用 daemon、持久 watch、真实批准评论、外部图床或 PR 电池。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这是围绕可信 prepare 与发布命令的 fail-closed 流程，不是操作系统沙箱。它不能证明后续命令始终在所选边界内，也不能阻止调用方绕过 prepare 另开 shell。预检还通过实时 GitHub 身份与权限 API 验证维护者，若 API 暂时失败，VM/宿主执行将失败而不是静默降级。
- 未验证或不属于本次范围：prepare 不重新验证评论后来被删除或权限后来被撤销的情况；强制 confinement 留给后续工作。上述无关且受负载影响的 autofix 超时仍是既有测试预算问题，已披露而不是隐藏。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：旧 container coordinate 调用以及旧 watch 快照保持兼容。缺少宿主批准及已验证 context digest 的旧宿主/VM 产物会被有意拒绝，应使用真实容器或执行新的预检。评论批准的新轮次还需要真实 watch 注册；验证维护者本人或同仓 PR 时，可以改为显式 `--trust-pr-head`，无需公开批准评论。

prs.title: feat(mods): let Mods read the environment and settings, and log telemetry
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lets Mods call `$.env.get`, `$.settings.read`, `$.telemetry.log` and `$.telemetry.mark` in every host that runs Mods, and adds `isColorless` to a command's `presentation`.

- `$.env.get(name)` answers the variable's value in the Qwen Code process, or `undefined`.
- `$.settings.read()` answers the settings the session runs under; `{ source }` answers one source (`user`, `project`, `policy`; `local` and `flag` read as `{}`); `{ key }` answers one top-level key.
- Credentials are kept from Mods:
  - a variable or settings key whose name marks a credential (`TOKEN`, `SECRET`, `API_KEY`, `PASSWORD` and the like) reads as unset or is left out;
  - so are the variables a settings `envKey`, `credentialEnv` or `apiKeyEnv` names, and each MCP server's `env` and `headers`;
  - because settings resolve `$VAR` as they load, any settings string containing a hidden variable's value is left out too.
  The name rule is the one the daemon already uses to redact worker diagnostics, moved to a shared helper.
- The reads are API events: another plugin's hooks hear `env.get` with `{name}` and `settings.read` with `{source?, layers}`, both pinned, and may answer or deny. A hook's answer reaches only the calling Mod, never the settings the session runs under.
- `$.telemetry.log` and `$.telemetry.mark` validate the entry, run the other plugins' hooks and then write it to the debug log as `telemetry.log (not sent): …`. Nothing is sent anywhere.
- In the Ink and OpenTUI terminals, `command.run` receives `presentation.isColorless: true` when `NO_COLOR` is set.
- The Mod worker asks the host for each read, so the credential rules live on the host side and another host can supply its own. A host without reads refuses both calls and leaves them out of `$.session.version()`.
- A design document in English and Chinese records the contract, Qwen's decisions and the host interface; the Mods guide gains a section.

## Why it's needed

Many Mods start by reading where they run: they check the terminal or CI through `$.env.get`, read a setting, and mark how a feature went. On current `main` each of these calls throws `Mod API not supported`, so the hook that makes it fails, and with it whatever the Mod draws or answers. Passing the environment and settings through unfiltered would hand sandboxed plugin code the model provider's keys and MCP tokens, which it could send to the model, into a prompt or into its store. The Mods examined read only terminal, CI and ordinary settings values, so hiding credentials breaks none of them. This is the second S1 step of the alignment plan in #13749.

A `$.model.complete` that meets a usage limit already fails at once (one attempt, `api-error` with `billing_error`), so it needs no change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable `experimental.mods`. In `~/.qwen/settings.json` also set `security.auth.apiKey` and an `env` entry such as `PROBE_TOKEN`; export `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Install a Mod whose command returns `$.env.get('HOME')`, `$.env.get('OPENAI_API_KEY')`, `$.env.get('PROBE_TOKEN')`, `$.settings.read({ key: 'security' })`, `$.settings.read({ key: 'env' })` and the result of `$.telemetry.log({ event: 'probe_ran', props: { n: 1 } })`.

- `qwen -p '/probe'` shows `HOME`, `undefined` for both credential variables, `security.auth` without `apiKey`, and `env` without `PROBE_TOKEN`. No secret appears on stdout or stderr, and no model request is made.
- With `--debug`, the debug log shows `telemetry.log (not sent): {"event":"probe_ran",…,"to":"anthropic"}`.
- The same command in Ink and OpenTUI shows the same lines.
- A command that returns its `presentation` shows `isColorless: true` under `NO_COLOR=1` and no such field otherwise.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (Qwen Code 0.27.4):

```
env HOME ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.env.get
settings general ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.settings.read
telemetry log ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.telemetry.log
```

After (bundled CLI, headless; Ink and OpenTUI show the same):

```
env HOME = "/tmp/…/home"
env OPENAI_API_KEY = undefined
env PROBE_TOKEN = undefined
settings general = {"enableAutoUpdate":false,"vimMode":true}
settings security = {"folderTrust":{"enabled":false},"auth":{"selectedType":"openai"}}
settings env = {"EDITOR":"vim"}
telemetry log = undefined
telemetry mark = undefined
```

```
presentation {"isFullscreen":true,"columns":120,"isColorless":true}   # NO_COLOR=1
presentation {"isFullscreen":true,"columns":120}                      # otherwise
```

A new integration test covers the headless reads and checks that no credential reaches the output.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Bundled CLI with an isolated `HOME` and a loopback model fixture; OpenTUI under Bun with `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`. Unit tests for the Mods runtime, the CLI host reads, the Mod session and the serve diagnostics redaction; the new integration test and the existing ACP Mods test.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the credential rules go by name and by resolved value. They may hide something that is not a credential (a string-valued `SESSION_TOKEN_LIMIT`), and they miss a credential typed literally under an ordinary key, such as a token in an MCP server's `args`. A Mod cannot read a hidden variable at all.
- Not validated / out of scope: `$.env.set`, sending telemetry anywhere, letting hooks change the session's own settings. macOS and Windows were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The serve diagnostics redaction now also recognizes camelCase and dashed names (`apiKey`, `X-Api-Key`), which only redacts more.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-27-mod-env-settings-telemetry.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-27-mod-env-settings-telemetry.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749. Follows #18435.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 Mod 在所有运行 Mod 的宿主里都能调用 `$.env.get`、`$.settings.read`、`$.telemetry.log` 和 `$.telemetry.mark`，并给命令的 `presentation` 加上 `isColorless`。

- `$.env.get(name)` 回答 Qwen Code 进程里这个变量的值，或 `undefined`。
- `$.settings.read()` 回答会话实际使用的设置；带 `{ source }` 时回答单个来源（`user`、`project`、`policy`；`local` 和 `flag` 读到 `{}`）；带 `{ key }` 时回答一个顶层键。
- 凭据不交给 Mod：
  - 名字像凭据（含 `TOKEN`、`SECRET`、`API_KEY`、`PASSWORD` 等）的变量或设置键，读起来就像未设置，或被去掉；
  - 设置里 `envKey`、`credentialEnv` 或 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的变量、每个 MCP 服务器的 `env` 和 `headers` 同样处理；
  - 设置在加载时会解析 `$VAR`，所以任何包含被遮住变量的值的设置字符串也会被去掉。
  按名字判断的规则就是 daemon 遮蔽 worker 诊断信息时已有的那条，这次抽成共用的工具函数。
- 这些读取是 API 事件：其他插件的 hook 收到 `env.get` 的 `{name}` 和 `settings.read` 的 `{source?, layers}`，两者都固定不可改，hook 可以作答或拒绝。hook 的回答只到达发起调用的 Mod，不会改变会话实际使用的设置。
- `$.telemetry.log` 和 `$.telemetry.mark` 校验 entry、运行其他插件的 hook，然后把它写进调试日志，形如 `telemetry.log (not sent): …`。不发送到任何地方。
- 在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 终端里，设置了 `NO_COLOR` 时，`command.run` 收到的 `presentation` 带 `isColorless: true`。
- Mod worker 每次读取都向宿主请求，所以凭据规则放在宿主一侧，其他宿主也能提供自己的实现。没有提供读取能力的宿主拒绝这两种调用，`$.session.version()` 里也不列出它们。
- 新增中英文设计文档，记录合同、Qwen 的设计决定和宿主接口；Mods 指南新增一节。

## 为什么需要

很多 Mod 一开始就要知道自己运行在什么环境里：用 `$.env.get` 判断终端或 CI、读一项设置、记录某个功能用得怎么样。在当前 `main` 上，这些调用都会抛出 `Mod API not supported`，发起调用的 hook 失败，这个 Mod 要画的内容或要给的回答也跟着没了。如果不加过滤地传递环境变量和设置，就等于把模型供应商的 key 和 MCP 的 token 交给沙箱里的插件代码，它可以把这些发给模型、写进 prompt 或存进自己的 store。检查过的 Mod 只读终端、CI 和普通设置的值，所以遮住凭据不会让它们出错。这是 #13749 对齐计划里 S1 的第二步。

`$.model.complete` 碰到用量上限时本来就立即失败（只请求一次，返回 `api-error` 和 `billing_error`），不需要修改。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

打开 `experimental.mods`。在 `~/.qwen/settings.json` 里再设置 `security.auth.apiKey` 和一个 `env` 条目（比如 `PROBE_TOKEN`），并导出 `OPENAI_API_KEY`。安装一个 Mod，它的命令返回 `$.env.get('HOME')`、`$.env.get('OPENAI_API_KEY')`、`$.env.get('PROBE_TOKEN')`、`$.settings.read({ key: 'security' })`、`$.settings.read({ key: 'env' })`，以及 `$.telemetry.log({ event: 'probe_ran', props: { n: 1 } })` 的结果。

- `qwen -p '/probe'` 显示 `HOME`；两个凭据变量都是 `undefined`；`security.auth` 里没有 `apiKey`；`env` 里没有 `PROBE_TOKEN`。stdout 和 stderr 里都没有任何秘密，也没有发出模型请求。
- 带 `--debug` 时，调试日志里有 `telemetry.log (not sent): {"event":"probe_ran",…,"to":"anthropic"}`。
- 同一条命令在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 里显示相同的行。
- 返回自身 `presentation` 的命令，在 `NO_COLOR=1` 下显示 `isColorless: true`，否则没有这个字段。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前（Qwen Code 0.27.4）：

```
env HOME ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.env.get
settings general ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.settings.read
telemetry log ! Error: Mod API not supported: $.telemetry.log
```

改动后（打包后的 CLI，headless；Ink 和 OpenTUI 显示相同）：

```
env HOME = "/tmp/…/home"
env OPENAI_API_KEY = undefined
env PROBE_TOKEN = undefined
settings general = {"enableAutoUpdate":false,"vimMode":true}
settings security = {"folderTrust":{"enabled":false},"auth":{"selectedType":"openai"}}
settings env = {"EDITOR":"vim"}
telemetry log = undefined
telemetry mark = undefined
```

```
presentation {"isFullscreen":true,"columns":120,"isColorless":true}   # NO_COLOR=1
presentation {"isFullscreen":true,"columns":120}                      # 其他情况
```

新增的集成测试覆盖 headless 下的读取，并检查没有凭据进入输出。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

打包后的 CLI，隔离的 `HOME`，本地回环的模型 fixture；OpenTUI 在 Bun 下运行，设置 `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`。单元测试覆盖 Mods 运行时、CLI 宿主读取、Mod 会话和 serve 诊断信息遮蔽；另外跑了新增的集成测试和现有的 ACP Mods 测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：凭据规则按名字和解析后的值判断。它可能遮住不是凭据的内容（字符串形式的 `SESSION_TOKEN_LIMIT`），也会漏掉直接写在普通键下的凭据，比如写进 MCP 服务器 `args` 的 token。被遮住的变量，Mod 完全读不到。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：`$.env.set`、把 telemetry 发到任何地方、让 hook 改变会话自身的设置。macOS 和 Windows 没有在本地跑。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。serve 的诊断信息遮蔽现在也能识别驼峰和带连字符的名字（`apiKey`、`X-Api-Key`），只会遮蔽得更多。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-27-mod-env-settings-telemetry.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-27-mod-env-settings-telemetry.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13749，接续 #18435。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): create the SDK GitHub release with the CI bot PAT
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The "Create GitHub Release and Tag" step of the SDK release workflow now authenticates `gh` with `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT` instead of the default `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`, matching the adjacent steps that commit/push the release branch and open the release PR. Because a PAT-created release emits `release: published`, the CLI-only finalization and OSS sync consumers now ignore tags outside the `v*` family while keeping manual dispatch. Regression tests pin both the token and the tag guards so a future revert is caught before a release run.

## Why it's needed

The stable SDK release for `v0.1.39` ([run 45935253272](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45935253272)) completed everything up to publication — `@qwen-code/sdk@0.1.39` was published to npm and the `release/sdk-typescript/v0.1.39` branch was pushed — then failed in the last release step:

```
! Failed to create release, "workflow" scope may be required.
```

`gh release create` needs the `workflow` scope, which the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` does not carry, so no `sdk-typescript-v0.1.39` tag or GitHub release exists. Because npm publish already happened, the failure leaves the release half-finished: consumers can install the package, but there is no release page or tag. Using the CI bot PAT that the neighbouring steps already use removes the failure mode.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused workflow test, which parses `.github/workflows/release-sdk.yml` and asserts the release step's `GITHUB_TOKEN` is `${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}`:

```bash
vitest run scripts/tests/release-sdk-workflow.test.js
```

Before the change that assertion fails (`expected '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}' to be '${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}'`); after it, all 10 tests in the file pass. The four workflow consumers that parse the changed release event gates also pass together (174 tests, 11 skipped). The full end-to-end confirmation is the next SDK release run: the "Create GitHub Release and Tag" step must create the tag and release without the "workflow scope may be required" error, and no CLI finalization/OSS sync run should start for the SDK tag.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — workflow configuration change; the before/after is the focused test result described above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest` run with a scratch install of `vitest@3` + `yaml@2` against the changed workflow file; no repository-wide install was performed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the step now depends on `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT` being present in `production-release`; if the secret is missing the step fails fast with an auth error instead of a `workflow`-scope error. The same secret already gates the following steps of every stable release, so availability is unchanged. PAT-created releases emit `release: published`; the CLI-only finalize and OSS sync consumers are now restricted to the `v*` tag family, so SDK tags do not start those runs.
- Not validated / out of scope: the workflow was not executed end to end locally (it requires the self-hosted release runner, npm credentials and the production environment); the next real SDK release is the confirming run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #18493

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

SDK 发布工作流中的「Create GitHub Release and Tag」步骤改为使用 `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`（而非默认的 `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`）为 `gh` 认证，与该步骤前后提交/推送发布分支、创建发布 PR 的步骤保持一致。由于 PAT 创建的 Release 会触发 `release: published`，CLI 专属的 finalize 与 OSS sync 消费者现在会忽略 `v*` 以外的 tag，同时保留手动 dispatch。回归测试同时固定 token 与 tag guard，避免以后被改回而在发布时才暴露。

## 为什么需要

`v0.1.39` 的正式 SDK 发布（[run 45935253272](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/45935253272)）在发布前的所有步骤均已成功——`@qwen-code/sdk@0.1.39` 已发布到 npm、`release/sdk-typescript/v0.1.39` 分支已推送——但最后一个发布步骤失败：

```
! Failed to create release, "workflow" scope may be required.
```

`gh release create` 需要 `workflow` 权限，而默认的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 不具备该权限，因此没有生成 `sdk-typescript-v0.1.39` 标签和 GitHub Release。由于 npm 包已经发布，这次失败让发布处于半完成状态：用户可以安装该包，但既没有 release 页面也没有标签。改用相邻步骤已在使用的 CI bot PAT 可以消除该失败模式。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

运行聚焦的 workflow 测试，它会解析 `.github/workflows/release-sdk.yml` 并断言发布步骤的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 为 `${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}`：

```bash
vitest run scripts/tests/release-sdk-workflow.test.js
```

修改前该断言失败（`expected '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}' to be '${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}'`），修改后该文件的 10 个测试全部通过。解析这些 release event 门禁的四个测试文件合计 174 个用例通过、11 个跳过。完整的端到端确认是下一次 SDK 发布：「Create GitHub Release and Tag」步骤应能在没有 "workflow scope may be required" 错误的情况下创建标签与 Release，且 SDK tag 不应启动 CLI finalize/OSS sync。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

N/A —— 这是工作流配置改动；修改前后的差异即上面描述的聚焦测试结果。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

在本地使用 `vitest@3` + `yaml@2` 的临时安装，针对修改后的 workflow 文件运行 `vitest`；未进行全仓库依赖安装。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：该步骤现在依赖 `production-release` 环境中存在 `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`；若密钥缺失，步骤会以认证错误快速失败，而不是 `workflow` 权限错误。该密钥本就约束每次正式发布的后续步骤，可用性没有变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：未在本地端到端执行该工作流（需要自托管发布 runner、npm 凭据和 production 环境）；下一次真实的 SDK 发布才是确认运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #18493

</details>

auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(ci): create the SDK GitHub release with the CI bot PAT

The "Create GitHub Release and Tag" step authenticated with the default
GITHUB_TOKEN, which lacks the `workflow` scope `gh release create` needs
here. v0.1.39 therefore published to npm and pushed its release branch,
then failed with "Failed to create release, \"workflow\" scope may be
required", leaving no tag or GitHub release behind (issue #18493).

The neighbouring steps (commit/push and release PR creation) already use
secrets.CI_BOT_PAT; use the same token for the release so the step can
complete after the package is already published.

Adds a regression test pinning the step's token so a revert is caught
before a future release.

* fix(ci): keep SDK releases out of the CLI release consumers

Creating the SDK release with CI_BOT_PAT (issue #18493) makes it emit
`release: published`, which GITHUB_TOKEN-created releases never did. Every
`sdk-typescript-*` tag now reaches the workflows watching that event, and two
of them cannot succeed on it: finalize-release exits 1 at "Validate stable
release tag", and sync-release-to-oss holds its single concurrency lock while
`gh release download` finds the assets an SDK release does not ship. Both
failures are observable on the PAT-created sdk-typescript-v0.1.29 release
(Finalize Stable Release and Sync Release to Aliyun OSS), and
dsw-swe-verified-release also starts a self-hosted gate job that only no-ops.

Guard all three job `if`s with the tag prefix their siblings already use
(release-managed-runtime.yml, release-vscode-companion.yml), keeping the
workflow_dispatch arm each declares. One test pins all three guards.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): share resident external Workspace across sessions [16023 B/2]
prs.body:
Split from #16023 at source commit `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935` (base `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e` on `main`); candidate B: `87766f263a51a`. This is **[16023 B/2]** — the shared resident external Workspace lifecycle, read-only concurrent dispatch, reattach, recovery/retirement services, and `EPHEMERAL` storage registration, separated from the unbound Session principal ownership migration in #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**). This PR targets `main` directly and compiles and runs independently of A/2.

## What this PR does

Adds the resident external-Workspace increment: a Session that needs an external Workspace tool provisions one worker, and later Sessions and Turns reuse that same Workspace-scoped binding instead of each closing cycle destroying it. Closing one Session becomes a membership release rather than a teardown of the shared binding.

It also lands the admission and lifecycle machinery that increment requires:
- Durable binding lookup (`findLatestForRequest`), trusted-startup recovery (`ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryService`, `RuntimeProvisionLostRecovery`), and terminal retirement (`ExternalWorkspaceRetirementService`) that refuse active or `UNKNOWN` executions and never auto-replace a `LIVE` or indeterminate runtime.
- Provider reattachment (`reattach`) for resident external Workspaces when an `observe` returns `UNKNOWN` after a provider restart, verifying the original endpoint and identity without provisioning a replacement.
- Read-only dispatch classification (`VerifiedDispatchPayload`, `shared_dispatch_class`) so verified read-only file tools run concurrently while writes stay fenced behind the binding, with a bounded shared-dispatch wait that settles stranded `PREPARED` rows at deadline.
- `EPHEMERAL` sandbox-owned Workspace registration sharing the same admission, ownership, migration, schema-projection, and inventory-eligibility rules as `EXTERNAL`.

## Why it's needed

Today an external Workspace cannot outlive the Session that first used it: closing the Session releases the binding and the next Session pays provisioning again, while concurrent readers queue behind the same fence as writers even when they cannot mutate anything. Separating this 70-file runtime and persistence increment (+4,676/−795) from the 99-file unbound Session principal migration (+7,684/−1,052) cuts the review surface in half and keeps this PR focused strictly on external Workspace binding lifetime, concurrency, and recovery fences.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused unit and H2 persistence suites from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalWorkspaceRetirementServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceOwnershipTest,ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest,ExternalWorkspaceProvisionerTest,ExternalRuntimeProvisionerTest,ExternalHttpRuntimeClientTest,ExternalWorkspaceBootContractTest,RuntimeBindingSessionReleaseTest,SharedExternalDispatchTest,RuntimeExecutionDispatcherTest
```

Expected:
- A second Session joining the same external Workspace reuses the active Workspace-isolated binding; closing the first Session releases only its membership while the last member under a storage retirement fence clears `ma_storage_owner`.
- Read-only file tools run concurrently on a shared external binding while write tools and `UNKNOWN` executions fence concurrent writes until settled or deadline-refused.
- Provider `UNKNOWN` on a resident Workspace triggers an authenticated `/runtime/reattach` against the saved original endpoint without provisioning a replacement; endpoint drift or `GONE` fails closed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — backend runtime broker and persistence change with no TUI/UI surface.

Local verification on macOS (JDK 21):

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) for offline reactor compilation; Linux and MySQL 8.4 lanes run in CI against `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: reshaping Workspace binding lifetime and session-close semantics is security- and data-safety-critical — a bug would either tear down a Workspace while another Session still uses it or replace a worker whose state is unknown. Two class-size ratchet pins rise with explicit design-doc annotations (`JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360 and `RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028; note that #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) subsequently extracts `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` and lowers `RuntimeBrokerService` back down to 2006).
- Not validated / out of scope: unbound Session principal ownership (`ma_session_principal`) is in #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**). Foreground external Shell execution is in #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) and #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: adds `shared_dispatch_class VARCHAR(16)` to `ma_tool_execution` in `V1__managed_schema.sql` and adds `reattach` to `ExternalRuntimeClient`.

Design:
- [Reattach the original external Workspace worker (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.zh-CN.md)
- [Retire external Workspaces after settled failures (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.zh-CN.md)
- [Class-size ratchet exception note (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #15512, #15247. Split from #16023 (`[16023 B/2]`).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #16023 的源码提交 `bd8c5c76011ad3c9011ef3a265a6eea44a86a935`（基于 `main` 的 `7f40ef8e4bd8b006bb84f6d5e95050f18335378e`）拆分而来；候选提交 B 为 `87766f263a51a`。本 PR 是 **[16023 B/2]** —— 包含常驻外部 Workspace 跨会话生命周期、只读并发派发、provider `reattach`、恢复与退役服务以及 `EPHEMERAL` 存储注册，与 #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**)（无绑定 Session principal 归属迁移）解耦。本 PR 直接以 `main` 为 base，可独立于 A/2 编译和运行。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落地「常驻外部 Workspace」增量：某个 Session 首次需要外部 Workspace 工具时创建一次 worker，之后的其他 Session 与 Turn 复用同一个 Workspace 作用域的绑定，而不是在每次关闭周期都销毁它。关闭单个 Session 变成成员释放，而不再拆除共享绑定。

同时补齐该增量所需的准入与生命周期机制：
- 持久化绑定查询（`findLatestForRequest`）、可信启动恢复（`ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryService`、`RuntimeProvisionLostRecovery`）与终态退役（`ExternalWorkspaceRetirementService`），拒绝存在活跃或 `UNKNOWN` 执行的操作，且绝不自动替换 `LIVE` 或状态不确定的 runtime。
- 常驻外部 Workspace 的 provider 重连（`reattach`）：当 provider 进程重启后 `observe` 返回 `UNKNOWN` 时，携带原 boot、scope、handle 和 endpoint 重连原 worker，绝不新建替换实例。
- 只读派发分类（`VerifiedDispatchPayload`、`shared_dispatch_class`）：经摘要校验的只读文件工具可并发执行，写操作仍受绑定级互斥围栏保护，并为共享派发等待设置超时上限，到期自动结算滞留的 `PREPARED` 记录。
- `EPHEMERAL` 沙箱自有 Workspace 注册：与 `EXTERNAL` 共享同一套准入、归属、迁移、Schema 投影与可用性判定规则。

## 为什么需要它

此前外部 Workspace 无法跨越首次使用它的 Session 存活：关闭 Session 会释放绑定，下一个 Session 必须重新创建 worker；同时只读并发请求也会排在写锁后面。将这 70 个文件的运行时与持久化改动（+4,676/−795）与 99 个文件的无绑定 Session principal 迁移（+7,684/−1,052）拆开后，评审面缩减一半，且可以直接基于 `main` 触发全量 CI。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行常驻外部 Workspace 相关的单元与持久化测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalWorkspaceRetirementServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceRecoveryServiceTest,ExternalWorkspaceOwnershipTest,ExternalWorkspaceMaterializationTest,ExternalWorkspaceProvisionerTest,ExternalRuntimeProvisionerTest,ExternalHttpRuntimeClientTest,ExternalWorkspaceBootContractTest,RuntimeBindingSessionReleaseTest,SharedExternalDispatchTest,RuntimeExecutionDispatcherTest
```

预期行为：
- 第二个 Session 加入同一外部 Workspace 时复用活跃的 Workspace 隔离绑定；关闭第一个 Session 仅释放其成员资格，只有在存储退役围栏下释放最后一个成员时才清空 `ma_storage_owner`。
- 只读文件工具在共享外部绑定上可并发执行，而写工具和 `UNKNOWN` 执行会围栏后续写操作，直到结算或超时拒绝。
- 常驻 Workspace 在 `observe` 返回 `UNKNOWN` 时会向原保存的 endpoint 发起带鉴权的 `/runtime/reattach`，不会新建替换实例；endpoint 漂移或 `GONE` 均 fail-closed。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯后端 Runtime Broker 与持久化变更）。

本地 macOS（JDK 21）验证：

```text
mvn -o test-compile → BUILD SUCCESS (全部 15 个模块通过)
```

### 测试平台

|   操作系统   | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
|  🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明（可选）

本地使用 JDK 21（`openjdk@21`）完成离线全模块编译校验；Linux 与 MySQL 8.4 通道由针对 `main` 的 CI 执行。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：重塑 Workspace 绑定生命周期与 Session 关闭语义涉及跨会话数据安全 —— 任何缺陷都会表现为在其他 Session 仍在使用时销毁 Workspace，或在状态未知时静默替换 worker。两个类尺寸 ratchet 上限带有明确的设计文档例外说明（`JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360，`RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028；其中 `RuntimeBrokerService` 在后续 #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) 抽离 `RuntimeDispatchPayloadAdmission` 后进一步回落至 2006）。
- 未验证 / 范围外：无绑定 Session principal 归属（`ma_session_principal`）位于 #17471 (**[16023 A/2]**)；外部前台 Shell 执行位于 #17473 (**[17357 A/2]**) 与 #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**)。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：在 `V1__managed_schema.sql` 的 `ma_tool_execution` 表中新增 `shared_dispatch_class VARCHAR(16)`，并在 `ExternalRuntimeClient` SPI 中新增 `reattach`。

设计文档：
- [Reattach the original external Workspace worker (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-external-reattach.zh-CN.md)
- [Retire external Workspaces after settled failures (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/managed-retirement-settled-failure.zh-CN.md)
- [Class-size ratchet exception note (EN)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/16023-resident-workspace/docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15512、#15247。拆自 #16023（`[16023 B/2]`）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): persist chat reasoning per task
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the chat thinking controls and `/effort` share task-scoped behavior in native Web Shell workspace tasks. Selecting a supported tier such as `high` enables thinking in the current task. The task record keeps that selection through model switches and restarts, including tasks whose existing records predate model preference snapshots.

## Why it's needed

Both chat entry points express a choice for the current task. New tasks continue to use defaults from settings. The daemon verifies model support and acknowledges the change after recording it so the chat can report a write failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create two tasks with thinking disabled. Select a high tier through the thinking control in one and type `/effort high` in the other. Check that the next request from each task sends the same tier.
2. Create a third task and verify it uses the configured default. Reopen the first two after restarting the daemon and confirm their selection. Repeat with a previously recorded task.
3. Select an unavailable tier, or attempt to save on a task whose recording is unavailable. Verify the operation reports an error and the shared settings remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The earlier CLI did not acknowledge the task-scoped menu write. The follow-up enables thinking through both paths, confirms the provider request body, and restores the selected tier after reopening. Chromium request checks cover the existing main and split chat controls.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Tested |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

### Environment

macOS arm64, Node.js 22, Chromium, a disposable profile, and a loopback model provider.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff** Task settings writes use the session recording path and can report an error if recording is unavailable.
- **Not validated / out of scope** OpenCode host integration and task-level context window editing.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes** Native workspace chats negotiate the daemon capability. Other clients can continue to call the existing configuration operation. Previously recorded tasks can accept a new task selection without converting their history.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #18490. The PR uses #18490 as its review base so the diff covers the chat behavior. The target will become `main` after #18490 merges.

Design documents [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/b7b295ce65bd9feb066b50a8d38c7d71725420d2/docs/design/web-shell-session-reasoning.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/b7b295ce65bd9feb066b50a8d38c7d71725420d2/docs/design/web-shell-session-reasoning.zh-CN.md).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

原生 WebShell 工作区任务的聊天思考控件和 `/effort` 采用相同的任务级行为。选择 `high` 等模型支持的档位会在当前任务开启思考。切换模型和重启后会从任务记录恢复选择，也支持模型偏好快照上线前创建的任务。

## 为什么需要

两个聊天入口都表达对当前任务的选择。新任务继续从设置读取默认值。daemon 校验模型能力并在写入记录之后确认变更，便于聊天界面反馈保存失败。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 创建两个关闭思考的任务。在一个任务的思考控件选高档，在另一个输入 `/effort high`。检查两个任务的下一次模型请求使用相同档位。
2. 新建第三个任务，确认它使用设置中的默认值。重启 daemon，重新打开前两个任务检查选择。用已有记录的任务重复验证。
3. 选择模型不支持的档位，或尝试在无法录制的任务保存。确认操作报错且共享设置保持原值。

### 改动前后的证据

旧版 CLI 未确认菜单的任务级写入。改动后两个入口都开启当前任务的思考，检查了实际请求，重开任务也能恢复选中的档位。Chromium 请求测试覆盖现有主聊天和分屏控件。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 已验证 |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

### 测试环境

macOS arm64、Node.js 22、Chromium、临时配置和本地模型桩。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍** 任务级写入需要录制，录制不可用时会向调用方返回错误。
- **验证范围之外** OpenCode 宿主接入和任务级上下文窗口编辑。
- **兼容性与迁移** 原生工作区聊天根据 daemon 能力接入。其他客户端仍可使用现有配置接口。旧任务可以直接保存新的任务选择。

## 关联事项

#18490 的后续 PR，评审目前以 #18490 为基线，差异只包含聊天行为。#18490 合入后将目标调整为 `main`。

设计文档 [英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/b7b295ce65bd9feb066b50a8d38c7d71725420d2/docs/design/web-shell-session-reasoning.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/b7b295ce65bd9feb066b50a8d38c7d71725420d2/docs/design/web-shell-session-reasoning.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(agents): keep A2A tasks recoverable after transcript read errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session-based A2A requests return the existing retryable JSON-RPC error `-32012` when a filesystem error prevents reply lookup in an active or archived transcript. The failing observation saves no task result. Once reads recover, the same task can report `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with its original reply.

## Why it's needed

A transient read error could make a recorded reply appear absent and cause a completed task to be permanently saved as `TASK_STATE_FAILED`. A permissions check can still succeed when the actual read fails. The linked issue reproduces this with injected `EIO`. [Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738), [earlier proposal and review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`, run `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`. The regression cases inject a stream read failure in each transcript location. Check that `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, and a replay of `SendMessage` return `-32012` with no internal path details and no saved task result. After restoring the stream, poll the same task with `GetTask` and check that it returns and saves `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. The cases also check the oversized archive and unexpected-error paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The local JSON-RPC daemon probe used the same recorded-reply fixtures for both versions. On installed Qwen Code 0.27.3, polling under `EIO` returned and saved `TASK_STATE_FAILED` for both transcript locations. Polling after recovery returned the same state. In the fixed bundle, polling under the same fault returned `-32012` and the task mappings contained no result. The next poll returned and saved `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. Healthy, missing-transcript, and mismatched-reply controls produced the expected results on both versions.

Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint and Prettier checks, and the focused CLI and core suites passed. The suites ran 22 CLI tests and 391 core tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0 arm64 and Node 22.18.0 for the fixed bundle. The probe used a local `serve` daemon with experimental agent collaboration enabled and synthetic on-disk fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- An unreadable active transcript takes precedence over the archived copy because the archive may hold a stale reply. The session loaders use strict reads by opt-in, with A2A as the sole caller that enables them.
- Previously saved failures, malformed reply records, and concurrent archive restoration are outside the fix. The existing cancellation decision and receipt behavior still depend on observing the task.
- The fix uses the existing task schema, storage format, and JSON-RPC code. It requires no data migration.

[Design document (Simplified Chinese)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13738

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

基于会话的 A2A 请求在活动或归档 transcript 因文件系统错误而无法查找回复时，返回现有的可重试 JSON-RPC 错误 `-32012`。本次失败的观测不会保存任务结果。读取恢复后，同一个任务可以返回 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。

## Why it's needed

瞬时读取错误可能让已记录的回复看起来缺失，导致已经完成的任务被永久保存为 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。即使实际读取失败，权限检查仍可能通过。关联 issue 使用注入的 `EIO` 复现了这个问题。[Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738)、[早期方案及评审](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797)。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

在 `packages/cli` 运行 `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`。回归用例分别在两处 transcript 注入流读取故障。确认 `GetTask`、`ListTasks`、`CancelTask` 和同请求重发的 `SendMessage` 返回 `-32012`，响应不包含内部路径，任务也没有保存结果。恢复读取后，通过 `GetTask` 查询同一个任务，确认返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。用例也检查归档超出大小限制和未预期错误的处理路径。

### Evidence (Before & After)

本地 JSON-RPC daemon 探针对两个版本使用了相同的已记录回复 fixture。使用已安装的 Qwen Code 0.27.3 时，两处 transcript 在 `EIO` 期间的查询都返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。读取恢复后查询仍返回相同状态。使用修复后的 bundle，在相同故障下查询返回 `-32012`，任务映射没有保存结果。下一次查询返回并保存了 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。正常 transcript、文件缺失以及回复属于其他 run 的对照在两个版本上均符合预期。

构建、打包、类型检查、定向 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查，以及 CLI 和 core 定向测试均通过。两套测试分别运行了 22 项和 391 项。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

修复后的 bundle 使用 macOS 27.0 arm64 和 Node 22.18.0。探针在启用实验性 Agent 协作的本地 `serve` daemon 中运行，使用合成的磁盘 fixture。

## Risk & Scope

- 活动 transcript 无法读取时优先报告该故障，因为归档副本里的回复可能已过时。加载器以显式启用的方式使用严格读取，只有 A2A 调用方启用。
- 之前已保存的失败、损坏的回复记录和并发归档还原超出本次修复范围。现有的取消决策和回执仍依赖于观测任务。
- 修复沿用现有任务数据结构、存储格式和 JSON-RPC 错误码，无需数据迁移。

[中文设计文档](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add scoped model defaults for new tasks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds per-model defaults for new tasks in Settings → Model. Users can enter an exact context window, see each model’s limit, and change thinking and effort where supported. The User and Workspace tabs keep separate drafts and allow each field to return to its inherited value.

The daemon records the effective defaults at task creation, including an empty preference map. The task reads the snapshot after reconnecting, switching models, or restarting the daemon.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell needs a place to set defaults for future tasks. A task records its starting preferences so a later settings save affects tasks created after that save.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create task A with a 200,000-token window and low effort before saving any defaults. While A is responding, save a 128,000-token window and high effort in Settings → Model. Create B and check that it uses the saved values. Continue A, switch models and back, and restart the daemon. Check both tasks’ settings and the next provider request.
2. In the Workspace tab, save preferences for two models. Reset one field to inherited and read it back. Reset one model’s last override and check that the other model’s values stay saved. Try an over-limit value and verify that neither settings file changes after a rejected batch.
3. Configure a proxy through `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and an explicit second endpoint for the same model ID. Check that each effective route appears once and that new tasks receive the saved value. Reload after the catalog changes and check that other drafts remain available.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The installed preview CLI returned HTTP 404 for the preferences route. The initial revision also left stale values after a partial reset and duplicated the proxy-routed model. The corrected build stores the task snapshot before the first save, removes the reset field from the settings file, and applies edits using the effective endpoint key. Local browser verification covered the settings panel and workspace switching.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Tested |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

### Environment

macOS arm64, Node.js 22, bundled CLI, Chromium, disposable workspaces, and a loopback model provider.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff** Creation waits for the snapshot to be recorded and reports a failure if it cannot be persisted. Older records without a snapshot use the existing recovery path.
- **Not validated / out of scope** Chat thinking controls and `/effort` parity will be delivered separately. OpenCode host integration, model visibility, and session-level context window controls are follow-ups.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes** The preference routes and task snapshot are additive.

## Linked Issues

Builds on #18316. Design documents [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2aa09f352ba0e35ed01ec0090af8112a34604a77/docs/design/web-shell-model-preferences.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2aa09f352ba0e35ed01ec0090af8112a34604a77/docs/design/web-shell-model-preferences.zh-CN.md).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

在「设置 → 模型」提供按模型设置的新任务默认值。用户可以输入精确的上下文窗口、查看模型上限，并调整模型提供的思考开关和强度。「用户」和「工作区」各自保留草稿，每个字段可以恢复继承。

daemon 在任务创建时记录生效的默认值，包括偏好表为空的情况。任务重连、切换模型和重启 daemon 后会读取创建时的快照。

## 为什么需要

WebShell 需要一个设置未来任务默认值的入口。任务记录初始偏好，之后在面板保存的设置用于保存后创建的任务。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 保存任何偏好前，创建窗口为 200,000、强度为低的任务 A。在 A 回复期间，在「设置 → 模型」保存 128,000 窗口和高强度。创建 B 并确认它使用保存的值。继续 A，切换模型后再切回，重启 daemon。检查两个任务的配置和下一次实际模型请求。
2. 在「工作区」页为两个模型保存偏好。将一个字段恢复继承并重新读取。清除某个模型的最后一项覆盖，确认另一模型的值保持。输入越界值，检查整批拒绝后两级设置文件都未改变。
3. 通过 `OPENAI_BASE_URL` 配置代理，并给同一模型 ID 配置一个显式的第二端点。检查每条生效路由只出现一次，新任务采用保存的值。模型目录变化后重载，确认其他可用草稿仍能编辑。

### 改动前后的证据

本机预览版读取偏好路由时返回 HTTP 404。PR 初版在部分恢复继承后保留了旧值，并重复展示走代理的模型。修正后的构建会在首次保存前记录任务快照，从文件移除恢复继承的字段，并使用生效端点的标识应用偏好。本地浏览器验证覆盖了设置面板和切换工作区。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 已验证 |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

### 测试环境

macOS arm64、Node.js 22、打包后的 CLI、Chromium、临时工作区和本地模型桩。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍** 任务创建会确认快照已落盘，持久化失败时返回错误。没有快照的旧任务记录沿用现有恢复流程。
- **验证范围之外** 聊天思考控件和 `/effort` 的行为对齐独立交付。OpenCode 宿主接入、模型显示状态和任务内窗口调节留待后续。
- **兼容性与迁移** 偏好路由和任务快照为新增项。

## 关联事项

基于 #18316。设计文档 [英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2aa09f352ba0e35ed01ec0090af8112a34604a77/docs/design/web-shell-model-preferences.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2aa09f352ba0e35ed01ec0090af8112a34604a77/docs/design/web-shell-model-preferences.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(verify-pr): harden round-input byte and connection handoff
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens guest round-input delivery without adding a cloud provider or weakening the existing hardware-isolation requirement. The Node and Python clients now validate the same canonical manifest before downloading a bundle: exact field shapes, UTF-8/JSON parsing, whole-string identifiers, positive safe integer values, bounded byte limits and compatible Unicode blank-credential rules. Counts in transport headers must be ASCII digits. Integral numeric forms such as `4.0` and `4e0` keep their numeric meaning in both clients; booleans, fractions, non-finite values and unsafe integers remain rejected. Supported nullability and optional proxy configurations are retained, and integer normalization does not alter the original manifest bytes or digest.

The byte path is hardened across replacement, growth and failure. Git stdout/stderr uses a bounded combined buffer with a 64 KiB diagnostic allowance, while the actual payload budget remains independent and unchanged. Failures retain the relevant native or subsequent budget-error cause, and invalid byte limits cause no socket or output-directory side effects. Prebuilt input is verified from descriptors and copied incrementally under the effective budget into a private launcher-owned snapshot, rather than passing a mutable original path to two consumers. The snapshot is private mode-0600, copied in bounded chunks, checked for descriptor identity, link count, byte count and SHA-256, and ownership-checked promotion. A checked ordinary single-link launcher-private bundle can be atomically replaced on retry; existing symlinks, directories and multi-link objects are refused and preserved. Its caller-facing input path and the input server see the same validated bytes. The effective generation and copy budget is the smaller of the caller maximum and the guest's fixed 128 MiB cap; a larger host budget does not enable an oversized guest bundle or an unbounded diagnostic stream.

The guest bridge bounds simultaneous accepted clients at 64, releases slots only after the relay handler finishes, including upstream failure, and keeps the existing TCP rejection and request-limit semantics. The outer accepted-client thread and inner relay startup paths also clean up on `RuntimeError`, including waking an already-started relay, without suppressing unrelated endpoint errors. Host launchers receive a minimal environment rather than host credentials, while legacy launch behavior is preserved. Canonical directory identity and ancestor checks prevent base/head worktrees from becoming the same directory or nesting through case or symlink aliases without incorrectly rejecting independent case-sensitive or prefix-sharing siblings.

The original Linux review findings are addressed in place: accepted test sockets handle expected resets without disabling Linux's fatal unhandled-error policy, and permission checks use actual filesystem enforcement rather than a uid-0 skip. Expected malformed traffic remains an error; it is not silently accepted as evidence of recovery.

## Why it's needed

Node and Python could previously disagree about the very same manifest, allowing one client to continue into an inconsistent or unnecessarily late failure. Replacement or growth after initial hashing could make input data differ from the validated source, and an over-budget private copy introduced avoidable I/O. Late writer errors could promote incomplete data, while unconditional transient-file cleanup could remove a caller's valid file. Unbounded bridge concurrency and inherited launcher environments magnified the impact of hostile or simply overloaded inputs.

This PR makes validation close to the actual cause and preserves resource ownership through failure. It does not claim to make an invalid PR verified, turn host UDS into hardware AF_VSOCK, or remove legitimate slow streams. The guest cap remains a concurrency/backpressure bound, not a new authorization policy, HTTP 429 policy, or total processing budget. The 64-client limit and existing time/byte thresholds were not loosened to make tests succeed.

[English design](docs/design/2026-11-25-verify-pr-round-input-hardening.md) · [中文设计](docs/design/2026-11-25-verify-pr-round-input-hardening.zh-CN.md)

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Exercise malformed UTF-8 and JSON, BOM-prefixed input, invalid framing, missing or unknown manifest fields, blank Unicode credentials, Unicode length declarations and out-of-range safe-integer values in both clients. They should reject before the bundle request or output promotion. Confirm valid nullable fields, meaningful Unicode credentials, `4.0`, `4e0`, and ordinary positive integers still work, and fractional values still fail.
2. Replace a prebuilt file after its initial validation, grow a single-link source after the copy has begun, and collide with the exact staging filename. The first two cases must fail before tokens, listeners or backend allocation. The growth case, with a 1024-byte caller budget, stops after writing the initial 64 bytes and never writes the enlarged suffix; its private staging is cleaned. The collision must preserve the caller's file and original SHA-256. The unchanged valid-file control must deliver identical bytes to the backend handoff and real input UDS. Also rewrite a same-size source after its first hash: the final complete digest must reject it without allocation. Run twice with one launcher and prebuilt bundle; both rounds must reach the allocator sentinel, while the bare-link control reproduces EEXIST. Existing unsafe private objects must remain untouched, and invalid entropy must reject before reading the source. Git diagnostic output may use only the bounded allowance and must not enlarge payload.
3. Drive a large transfer through a delayed real writer. The client socket should pause/resume as its writer reaches backpressure, and its queue should stay bounded. A late real write error must prevent promotion. Manifest, bundle and entropy files should be staged and promoted separately, preserving unrelated existing outputs if a later promotion fails. A late actual bundle-read growth or replacement cannot reuse the initial small-file identity as a larger valid input.
4. Run the bridge against six bursts of 96 TCP clients, with at most 64 genuine simultaneous upstreams. After each burst require zero upstream activity and settled accept/handler/reject lifecycles before continuing. Exercise unavailable-upstream recovery and healthy echo afterward; no budget or polling deadline is increased. Inject an outer client-thread startup failure and a second relay startup failure: the failed client and any already-started relay must close, the connection slot must return, subsequent healthy echo must succeed, and no unexpected thread traceback is allowed. Also exercise explicit incomplete and hostile framing rather than treating arbitrary unfinished streams as successful recovery.
5. Check launcher environments and directory identity. The default child must not inherit model or GitHub credentials and retains only PATH (with the documented fallback). An aliased or nested base/head worktree pair must stop before Git initialization, while two independent siblings sharing a path-name prefix still materialize correctly.
6. Run the permission-sensitive scratch cleanup and unreadable-config checks with capabilities removed, not merely as ordinary root. The helper clears `CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE|CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH`, prevents uid-0 exec from restoring them, and observes real `EACCES` on a mode-000 directory. Record two passing targets, with other cases excluded only by the explicit test-name filter. Removing the scratch cleanup or the expected-reset listener in disposable controls should again expose the defect being pinned.

**Measured local evidence for `024ec6a`:** the three focused suites have **67 passing checks** on macOS arm64/Node 24.18.1. The eleven relevant Linux suites have **541 passing checks and 8 environment skips** on Linux aarch64/Node 22.23.5, using the preserved bridge burst parameters and 5-second polling bounds. The real restricted-root witness has **2 passing permission targets and 40 skips caused only by test-name filtering**. Root lint, typecheck, build and bundle pass, with the pre-existing VSCode warnings (30 warnings, zero errors) rather than suppressing unrelated warnings. An original native `spawnSync` overflow now has a real 2 MiB random-data Git fixture with a 1 MiB payload limit; its native cause and payload budget are both pinned. Startup-failure bridge tests fill the remaining capacity with 63 held healthy clients, then check two echoed recoveries while waiting for completed relay pairs. The diagnostics driver measures each real `result.stderr.length`; removing that observation fails the driver. These local suites are not represented as a replacement for the explicit GitHub CI checks on this PR head.

**Real Linux/KVM evidence at the current guest source SHA-256 `8d00890261d7ab4e7b453209a65df8536cd50f52a28f644fb3b78e42f97b2f8b`:** three independently derived Firecracker/KVM images were created from pinned golden assets. Healthy default production spawn, a real small two-OID prebuilt Git bundle and real VSOCK passed **15 checks**, including bundle/entropy agreement, HTTP 200/401/429, nonce matching, token revocation and ownership cleanup. Invalid UTF-8 from the fault peer passed **3 checks** with no promoted inputs. Unicode-header rejection plus the bounded bridge passed **73 checks**, with 64 genuinely active upstreams before release, no overflow upstream, one healthy recovery attempt and zero residual upstreams. There was no guest NIC or directory share, and both source golden assets and teardown were verified. These measurements use real VM processes but local synthetic upstream fixtures, not an external model or a public cloud provider.

**Committed-source provenance for `024ec6a`:** the five-file committed delta has +159/-38 lines and no production implementation change. Its `git archive` embeds commit `024ec6af9be198f4c4167ca6d456fbf08e6c499f` and has SHA-256 `48593f7c91fbb22b3b58f212f6e203f3388f270de82cf664706f1889bbf67459`. The Linux replay applies that delta to the previously completed f33 committed-source archive environment (full archive SHA-256 `295ce3cbb5d6c9c57610d9f6a90374e5e4357df425cfa8df4d12c35b747dd643`); it is not claimed to be a fresh full-source 024ec6a archive. All three production hashes are identical to the KVM-tested implementation: guest `8d00890261d7ab4e7b453209a65df8536cd50f52a28f644fb3b78e42f97b2f8b`, channel `a95d411d836dbaefd3229a9d0661518142015bf5a7ca13d798bc445a47bedc0d`, runner `41a404e7ac0e67289abb6d89e35f4789d762f3b05f22f7e88a314956f7696738`. The three modified test blob IDs also match across both verification endpoints. The source archives are not guest round-input bundles and do not bypass the 128 MiB guest limit. The retained f33 baseline completes its frozen-lockfile build; the current-delta Linux replay has **11 passing files, 541 passing checks and 8 environment skips**, and its capability witness has **2 passing permission targets and 40 test-name-filter skips**. That witness records `CapEff=0`, `CapBnd=…f9`, `NoNewPrivs=1`, and real `EACCES` for both operations on a mode-000 directory. The existing KVM evidence remains applicable to the identical implementation bytes but is not represented as a new VM replay for this test-only delta. These outcomes and the explicit public CI/review verdicts remain distinct gates, not proof of maintainer approval.

**Bounded timing caveat:** one earlier contended Linux burst produced a five-second `accepted=97 / completed=95` matcher timeout. Three subsequent complete replays of the current source did not reproduce it while preserving the same client count, cap and deadline. The earlier snapshot has no failure-time thread stack, so it remains **NOT_REPRODUCED rather than verified fixed**. New failure-only SIGUSR1 traces preserve later thread-state evidence without increasing the timing, capacity or reset requirements.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No user-interface changes are involved, so screenshots are not applicable.

- Before: replacement after the first hash could give consumers bytes different from the manifest, and copying an enlarged source could write far beyond its small caller budget. After: both consumers use the verified private copy; a copy-time growth is rejected after writing only the already-read, in-budget prefix, with no backend allocation.
- Before: an existing staging path could fail with `EEXIST` and then be unlinked even when it was the caller's valid input. After: ownership is acquired only by exclusive creation and stage deletion requires matching descriptor identity; promotion refuses unsafe existing objects, while a checked ordinary single-link launcher-private bundle can be replaced on a legitimate retry.
- Before: burst connections had no explicit concurrent bound. After: the peak remains 64, overflow is refused without opening a new upstream, lifecycle completion releases slots, and healthy echo recovers without changing raw TCP or request-budget semantics.
- The original review's reset listener was removed in a private control and produced real unhandled `ECONNRESET` failures; the current accepted-socket handling prevents those unexpected uncaught errors without disabling fatal Linux policy. Removing the scratch cleanup in a separate control leaves a real scratch directory and fails the intended assertion; the guarded cleanup passes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Focused suites and root lint/typecheck/build/bundle on arm64, Node 24.18.1 |
|  🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not locally validated; POSIX file/socket tests are not presented as Windows evidence |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ Local aarch64 integration and real Firecracker/KVM replay; exact public PR-head validation is tracked with the linked CI/replay gates above |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64 with Node 24.18.1; authorized Linux aarch64 with Node 22.23.5, real TCP/UDS, and Firecracker 1.18.0/KVM with kernel 6.1.102. Frozen workspace dependencies use pnpm 11.24.0. Inputs use genuine small Git two-OID fixtures and local synthetic upstreams. No external model requests, real API credentials, or new cloud instances were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: verified private copying and an additional incremental digest require extra local I/O and careful descriptor/ownership handling. The implementation uses bounded chunks rather than buffering an entire bundle. It intentionally refuses unsafe staging collisions and aliases instead of overwriting caller files. These checks depend on ordinary regular-file and POSIX filesystem semantics; unusual remote filesystem behavior or a trusted operator modifying a private file are not covered by a blanket immutability claim.
- Not validated / out of scope: no new provider/data plane, Apple vfkit, Windows IPC, provider-vm or fcsandbox round is claimed. No entire-qwen-code-history bundle was validated as fitting the guest cap; real VM input uses a small two-OID repository. Non-local filesystem zero-progress writes and extraordinary close failures were not established by the review. Full external-provider credentials, live cloud allocations, and external model output are intentionally not exercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: invalid manifest shapes, unsupported numeric values, malformed framing, unsafe aliases and unsafe staging/racing inputs now fail consistently and fail closed. Valid legacy container, manual-vm, waived and no-round-input workflows, plus TCP/fallback UDS modes, retain their existing routes; legacy alternate-directory and non-empty-string cases are not accidentally removed because of filename case or Unicode content. The guest bridge limit is financial-independent backpressure, not a request quota or an idle-stream kill time.

## Linked Issues

Related context: #10438 (keeping unexpected unhandled errors fatal on Linux). No additional issue is closed by this change.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 加固 guest 的 round-input 交付链路，不新增云 provider，也不降低已有硬件隔离要求。Node 与 Python 客户端在下载 bundle 前采用一致的 canonical manifest 校验：字段形状、UTF-8/JSON、完整字符串标识符、正安全整数、字节预算以及一致的 Unicode 空白凭据规则。传输帧头只接受 ASCII 数字。`4.0`、`4e0` 等 JSON 整值数字在两端保留同样的数值含义；布尔值、小数、非有限值与 unsafe integer 仍被拒绝。已有可空字段与可选代理配置继续兼容，内部数字正规化不会改写原始 manifest 字节或摘要。

字节链路覆盖替换、增长和失败等情形。Git 的 stdout/stderr 总缓冲区有界，诊断输出仅额外允许 64 KiB，真实载荷预算不随之放宽。原生或后续预算错误的原因得到保留，非法字节预算不会产生 socket 或输出目录副作用。prebuilt 输入从文件描述符验证后，在实际预算内以分片方式复制到私有 launcher 持有的快照，不再把可变的原始路径交给两个消费者。快照为私有 mode-0600，复制受分块预算约束，并通过描述符身份、链接数、字节数与 SHA-256 核验；经检查的 launcher 私有单链接普通 bundle 可在合法重试时原子替换；既有 symlink、目录和多链接对象都被拒绝并保持原样。backend 收到的输入路径与 input server 因而看到同一份已验证字节。调用方预算与 guest 固定的 128 MiB 上限继续分离，较大的宿主预算不会放行超容 guest bundle。

guest 桥接同时最多接受 64 个客户端，仅在 relay handler 完成（包括 upstream 失败）后归还名额，并保留原有 TCP 拒绝与请求次数限额语义。外层客户端线程和内层 relay 的启动失败同样清理资源；第二个 relay 失败时会唤醒已启动的 relay，不吞掉无关 endpoint 错误。宿主启动器只获得最小环境，但不继承宿主凭据；原有启动行为继续保留。工作区的规范化路径与祖先链身份检查会阻止 base/head 通过大小写或 symlink 变成同一目录或嵌套目录，同时不会误伤大小写敏感或仅共享名称前缀的独立兄弟目录。

原 Linux 评审的两项问题均在原位修复：测试接受的 socket 对预期 reset 挂载处理，不会关闭 Linux 对未处理错误的致命策略；权限用例改为依据真实文件系统权限执行，而不是按 uid 0 固定跳过。非法或恶意流量仍保持拒绝，不被当作恢复成功的证据。

## 为什么需要

此前 Node 与 Python 可能对同一份 manifest 得出不同接受结果，让一端继续进入不一致状态或产生不必要的晚期失败。首次 hash 后的替换或增长可能使交付数据偏离已核验的来源，而过度复制的私有文件还会造成不必要的 I/O。晚到的 writer 错误可能提升截断的数据，无条件清理临时文件又可能误删调用方的合法文件。桥接并发缺乏上限以及启动器继承宿主环境，会进一步放大恶意或过载输入的影响。

本 PR 将校验放到原因发生的位置，并在失败路径上保持资源所有权。它不把非法 PR 变成已通过验证，不把宿主 UDS 说成硬件 AF_VSOCK，也不会禁止合法的慢流。64-client 上限与既有时间/字节门限均没有为取得通过而放宽。该上限是并发/backpressure 控制，不是新增认证策略、HTTP 429 策略或总处理预算。

[English design](docs/design/2026-11-25-verify-pr-round-input-hardening.md) · [中文设计](docs/design/2026-11-25-verify-pr-round-input-hardening.zh-CN.md)

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在两端驱动非法 UTF-8/JSON、BOM 前缀、非法帧、缺失或额外 manifest 字段、Unicode 空白凭据、Unicode 长度声明和超出安全整数范围的值。它们应在 bundle 请求或提升前失败。确认合法可空字段、具有实际内容的 Unicode 凭据、`4.0`、`4e0`、普通正整数仍然可用，小数值仍然被拒绝。
2. 在首次校验后替换 prebuilt、在复制开始后扩展同一单链源，并令 staging 文件名精确碰撞。前两种情形必须在 token、listener、backend 分配之前失败。调用方预算为 1024 字节时，增长用例仅写入已读取的 64 字节，不写扩展尾部，并清理本轮 staging。碰撞必须保留调用方文件及其原始 SHA-256。未变异的合法文件控制则必须把同样的字节送到 backend handoff 与真实 input UDS。再在首次 hash 后写入同长度不同内容：最终完整摘要必须拒绝，且不能分配 backend。使用同一 launcher、同一 prebuilt 连续运行两次，两次必须到达分配器哨兵；恢复 bare link 后应重现 EEXIST。unsafe 私有目标保持原样，非法 entropy 必须在读取来源前拒绝。诊断输出只能使用有界余量，不能增加载荷预算。
3. 使用延迟的真实 writer 验证回压。客户端 socket 应根据 writer 达到回压而 pause/resume，队列保持有界；晚到的真实写入错误会阻止提升。manifest、bundle、entropy 分别暂存并逐个提升，后续提升失败时保留与本轮无关的既有输出。复制期间再次发生的 bundle 增长或替换不能把先前小文件的身份当成更大的有效输入。
4. 连续六批各启动 96 个 TCP 客户端，真实同时上游不得超过 64。每批后要求 upstream 活动归零，且 accept/handler/reject 生命周期结算完整才继续。还要验证 upstream 不可用时名额归还及随后健康 echo；不增加预算或轮询时限。分别注入外层线程和第二个 relay 的启动失败：失败客户端及已启动 relay 必须结束、名额归还、后续健康 echo 成功，不允许出现意外线程 traceback。另有明确的不完整流量与恶意帧测试，不把任意未完成的流当作成功恢复。
5. 检查启动器环境和目录身份。默认子进程不继承模型/GitHub 凭据，只保留 PATH（以及文档中的 fallback）。别名或嵌套的 base/head worktree 必须在初始化 Git 之前停止；共享路径名称前缀但彼此独立的兄弟目录仍能正确展开。
6. 用真实剥离 capabilities 的 root 运行 scratch 清理和不可读配置用例，而不是只用普通 root。helper 清除 `CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE|CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH`，阻止 uid-0 exec 恢复它们，并真实观察到 mode-000 目录读写返回 `EACCES`。两个目标用例通过，其余仅由显式测试名过滤器排除。若在一次性对照中删除 scratch cleanup 或预期 reset 的 listener，应再次暴露相应缺陷。

**当前 `024ec6a` 的本机证据：**macOS arm64、Node 24.18.1 的三份聚焦套件为 **67 项通过**。Linux aarch64、Node 22.23.5 的十一套相关套件为 **541 项通过、8 项因环境跳过**，保留原 bridge burst 参数与 5 秒轮询。真实受限 root witness 为 **2 个权限目标通过、40 项仅由测试名过滤器跳过**。仓库 lint、typecheck、build、bundle 均通过，保留未修改的 VSCode warning（30 条 warning、0 error）。新增真实 Git 用例以 2 MiB 随机数据和 1 MiB 载荷预算触发原生 `spawnSync` 溢出，同时钉住原始 cause 和实际载荷预算。线程启动失败后的 bridge 测试用 63 条保持中的健康连接填满剩余容量，再验证两次 echo 恢复，并等待 relay pair 实际完成。诊断 driver 逐次观测真实 `result.stderr.length`，移除该观测会令 driver 失败。这些本机结果不替代当前 PR head 上必须查看的 GitHub CI。

**当前 guest 源码 SHA-256 `8d00890261d7ab4e7b453209a65df8536cd50f52a28f644fb3b78e42f97b2f8b` 的真实 Linux/KVM 证据：**从固定 golden 资产独立派生三份 Firecracker/KVM 镜像。默认生产 spawn、小型真实双 OID prebuilt Git bundle 与真实 VSOCK 的 healthy 场景通过 **15 项检查**，验证 bundle/entropy 一致、HTTP 200/401/429、nonce 匹配、token 吊销和 ownership 清理。故障 peer 的非法 UTF-8 场景通过 **3 项检查**，没有提升输入。Unicode header 拒绝与受控桥接通过 **73 项检查**：释放前有 64 个真实活动上游，overflow 不创建新上游，一次恢复即健康，最终无残留上游。guest 无 NIC、无目录共享，golden 资产与 teardown 均已验证。这些是真实 VM 进程配合本机合成上游，不是外部模型调用或公共云 provider。

**当前 `024ec6a` 的已提交来源：**本轮五文件增量为 +159/-38，没有生产实现变化。该增量的 `git archive` 内嵌提交 `024ec6af9be198f4c4167ca6d456fbf08e6c499f`，SHA-256 为 `48593f7c91fbb22b3b58f212f6e203f3388f270de82cf664706f1889bbf67459`。Linux replay 将此正式增量应用于已经完成验证的 f33 提交 archive 环境，基线完整 archive 的 SHA-256 为 `295ce3cbb5d6c9c57610d9f6a90374e5e4357df425cfa8df4d12c35b747dd643`；不称其为全新完整 024ec6a archive。三个生产实现与已测 KVM 实现字节一致：guest `8d00890261d7ab4e7b453209a65df8536cd50f52a28f644fb3b78e42f97b2f8b`、channel `a95d411d836dbaefd3229a9d0661518142015bf5a7ca13d798bc445a47bedc0d`、runner `41a404e7ac0e67289abb6d89e35f4789d762f3b05f22f7e88a314956f7696738`。三个修改测试的 Git blob 也在两端一致。源 archive 不是 guest round-input bundle，不因此绕过 128 MiB 上限。保留的 f33 基线已完成 frozen-lockfile 构建；当前增量的 Linux 测试为 **11 文件通过、541 项通过、8 项因环境跳过**。权限 witness 为 **2 个权限目标通过，40 项仅由测试名过滤器跳过**，实际 `CapEff=0`、`CapBnd=…f9`、`NoNewPrivs=1`，mode-000 目录读写均返回 `EACCES`。既有 KVM 实测适用于这些完全相同的实现字节，但本轮只改测试/文档，不称其为一次新 VM replay。公开 CI、评审决定仍须分别核对，以上均不表示维护者已经批准。

**有界的时序边界：**早期一次 Linux 并发 burst 出现 5 秒内 `accepted=97 / completed=95` 的 matcher 超时。其后三次当前源码完整 replay 均通过，客户端数量、上限和时限保持不变。旧快照没有失败时线程栈，因此仍是 **NOT_REPRODUCED，不是已验证修复**。新增加仅在真实失败后捕获 SIGUSR1 线程栈的取证，不增加时限、放宽容量或忽略 reset。

### 修复前后证据

这里没有用户界面改动，因此不适用截图。

- 修复前：首次 hash 后替换文件，可能使消费者收到与 manifest 不同的字节；扩展源复制可能写出远超调用方预算的数据。修复后：两个消费者使用已验证的私有副本，复制期间的增长在写入已读取、预算内前缀后被拒绝，且不分配 backend。
- 修复前：staging 路径已有对象时，`EEXIST` 后还可能 unlink 调用方的有效输入。修复后：仅由独占创建获得所有权，清理要求描述符身份一致，unsafe 既有目标不会被覆盖；合法的 launcher 私有单链接普通 bundle 则支持重试替换。
- 修复前：burst 连接没有显式并发上限。修复后：峰值为 64，overflow 不新建上游，生命周期完成后归还名额，健康 echo 恢复，且不改变 raw TCP 或请求预算语义。
- 原评审要求的 reset listener 在私有对照中删除后，真实重现了未捕获的 `ECONNRESET`；当前接受 socket 的处理避免意外未处理错误，同时保留 Linux 致命策略。另一个对照删除 scratch cleanup 后留下真实残留目录并使断言失败，有界清理则通过。

### 已测试的平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ arm64、Node 24.18.1，聚焦套件及根 lint/typecheck/build/bundle |
|  🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本机验证；POSIX 文件/socket 测试不作为 Windows 证据 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 本机 aarch64 集成及真实 Firecracker/KVM 重放；确切公开 PR-head 的验证按上文 CI/replay 条件单独核对 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node 24.18.1；授权 Linux aarch64、Node 22.23.5、真实 TCP/UDS，以及 Firecracker 1.18.0/KVM（kernel 6.1.102）。冻结的工作区依赖使用 pnpm 11.24.0。输入使用小型真实双 OID Git 夹具和本机合成上游。没有外部模型请求、真实 API 凭据或新云实例。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：经过验证的私有复制与增量摘要会带来额外本地 I/O，并要求仔细处理描述符及所有权。实现使用有界分片而非把整个 bundle 读入内存；遇到不安全的 staging 碰撞或别名时有意拒绝，不覆盖调用方文件。这依赖普通 regular file 与 POSIX 文件系统语义，不承诺任意远端文件系统或受信操作者改私有文件后仍具绝对不可变性。
- 未验证/不在范围：不宣称新增 provider/数据面，不覆盖 Apple vfkit、Windows IPC、provider-vm 或 fcsandbox。没有用完整 qwen-code 历史证明能落入 guest 上限；真实 VM 输入仍是小型双 OID 仓库。非本地文件系统的零进展写入和异常 close 未由复核覆盖。未使用真实 provider 凭据、实际云分配或外部模型输出。
- 破坏性变化/迁移说明：非法 manifest 形状、不支持的数字、非法帧、危险别名以及 unsafe staging/race 输入现在一致 fail closed。有效的 legacy container、manual-vm、waived、无 roundInput 工作流，以及 TCP/备用 UDS 路线保持原路线；不会因为文件名大小写或 Unicode 内容误删合法的替代目录和非空字符串。桥接上限是独立于费用的 backpressure，不是请求配额或 idle-stream 杀超时。

## 关联事项

相关背景：#10438（Linux 对意外未处理错误保持致命）。本次没有额外关闭 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): switch App main chat column onto shared ChatSurface (slice 2f.3)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR switches the main daemon chat column onto the shared backend-neutral chat surface backed by the daemon controller adapter, completing structural rendering convergence across all three chat columns (Managed sessions, split/side-task panes, and the main daemon column) while keeping streaming-tail performance isolation, relayout boundaries, empty-state vertical centering, host chrome, and visual layout unchanged:

- **Extends the shared chat surface with minimal backend-neutral host seams and memoized command stability.** The shared chat surface now memoizes the command array passed into the composer editor so transcript-only updates do not defeat editor memoization on any host, combines host-level modal dialog locks with active permission cards, avoids nesting duplicate approval overlay test identifiers, and adds optional seams for a host-rendered transcript subtree (preserving streaming-tail isolation and conversation search), footer ref/style/header/trailing chrome (keeping custom footers, usage stats, and welcome footers outside the approval-hidden wrapper), decision container ref measurement, and independent question keyboard focus authority. Omitting these optional seams keeps all existing defaults unchanged.
- **Switches the main daemon chat column onto the shared chat surface.** The main chat column now binds the shared-state daemon controller adapter (gating outer pending permissions to the active chat view), routes tool approvals, question submissions/dismissals, and the imperative host permission API through the adapter while preserving plan-mode handoff locks and single-report diagnostic causes, deletes direct inline rendering of the tool approval card, question card, and composer editor along with the redundant question handler, and uses `display: contents` on the surface root inside the chat subtree so the transcript and footer remain direct flex children of the relayout-bounded viewport in both active and empty states.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-11-27-app-main-chat-surface-switch.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-27-app-main-chat-surface-switch.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

After converging the Managed sessions page and the split/side-task chat pane onto the shared chat surface, the main daemon chat column remained the last chat column rendering tool approvals, user questions, and the composer editor inline with duplicated approval/question wiring. Moving the main column onto the shared surface puts every chat column in Web Shell onto one shared surface, eliminates the last copy of inline decision-card and composer orchestration, and clears the path for capability-gated parity and bundle boundary enforcement.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open an empty main chat session and an active main chat session with a pending tool approval; verify the main chat column renders through the shared chat surface with zero layout drift compared to `main` in both empty welcome centering and active approval layout, with a single approval overlay container.
2. Approve the tool request, answer a subsequent user question in the main chat column, confirm both resolve cleanly and restore the composer with its toolbar intact, and verify stopping a live streaming turn from the main composer dispatches the daemon cancel request cleanly.
3. Verify switching approval modes during a pending plan approval continues to serialize handoff and surface localized mode-pending / transport failure diagnostics in a single toast without double-reporting, and confirm transcript-only streaming updates do not trigger redundant composer editor re-renders.
4. Run the unit, CSS contract, integration, artifact, Playwright E2E, typecheck, and build gates:

   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts client/e2e/web-shell.split-persist.spec.ts --project=chromium` (8 tests passed)
   - `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` (clean)
   - `npm run build --workspace=@qwen-code/web-shell && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=6144" npm run typecheck` (clean)

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Main-column local slash commands, inline shell queueing, optimistic echo, turn-cancel take-back, and the streaming-tail isolated transcript host remain behind the shared surface's optional host seams rather than being folded into the controller in this PR, preserving performance isolation and submission behavior until a dedicated submit-pipeline convergence pass.
